title: Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms
description: There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week. GDP growth is up, but so are prices. For now at least, interest rates are staying the same. What does that mean for the midterm elections?
text:
There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week. For now at least, interest rates are staying the same. There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week.

For now at least, interest rates are staying the same. New GDP numbers show the U.S. economy is growing at a healthy clip, but inflation remains stubbornly high. The Federal Reserve met and decided not to raise interest rates, but higher borrowing costs could still be in store by the end of the year.

NPR's Scott Horsley is with us to explain. SCOTT HORSLEY, Hi.
